scope: Predeclared native2048 ten-map pilot; numerical validity, primary spectral consistency and separate BB lens-model diagnostics
primary_gate_method: Approximate Student-t with df=N-1; Bonferroni over three fitted amplitudes and 117 signed bin residuals, splitting familywise alpha equally between amplitude and shape. No sample covariance inversion.
BB_note: Real mmDL non-Gaussian kappa differs from continuum CAMB PP and gives correlated BB sample variance. Report pure-CAMB and same-primary measured-kappa two-point references separately; do not tune thresholds or source spectra to hide a mismatch.
